label: candid-baseline

measurement_protocol.synchronous_gc: included in instruction count; reclaimed_bytes reported
measurement_protocol.canister_cleanup: stop and delete after each completed phase

methodology: Fresh canister per workload/trial/phase. Configure constructs immutable fixtures and each format input outside timing; four forced GC increments follow. Encode/decode are separate synchronous updates, including success unwrapping and retaining the result. Counter/assignment overhead is included. Synchronous GC is included and reported; end-of-message GC is excluded. Byte counts belong to encode phases; decode replies are a 2-byte correctness marker. Fresh-per-phase override: each implementation phase installs and configures an independent canister; configure must produce equivalent inputs without depending on the canister ID or previous phases.
correctness: The unmeasured bytesResult query compares every complete decoded value with its independent deterministic fixture; encode phases also decode and compare before returning bytes. CandidX bytes additionally match host canonicalization of ordinary Candid. Schemas mirror Takt Events/child admission and Reactor Batch from their v1 contracts; Rechain is a representative action batch, not an integration benchmark.
